ledger_entries_sign.name: ledger_entries_sign
ledger_entries_sign.value: ("ledger_entries"."type" = 'charge' and "ledger_entries"."amount_piastres" > 0) or ("ledger_entries"."type" = 'payment' and "ledger_entries"."amount_piastres" < 0) or ("ledger_entries"."type" = 'reversal' and "ledger_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is not null)

ledger_entries_payment_fields.name: ledger_entries_payment_fields
ledger_entries_payment_fields.value: "ledger_entries"."type" <> 'payment' or ("ledger_entries"."method" is not null and "ledger_entries"."receipt_no" is not null)

users_phone_or_email.name: users_phone_or_email
users_phone_or_email.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null
